svg.title: Commission accrual, clawback, and payment
svg.desc: Commission accrual, clawback, and payment. How does a payment identify its accruals and adjustments? Primary tables: SalesCommissionRate, SalesCommissionAccrual, SalesCommissionAdjustment, SalesCommissionPayment, SalesCommissionPaymentLine. The accrual stores both the invoice-line and rate keys. Payment lines use a type-qualified source ID; commissions settle separately from payroll.
